predecessors.name: Western Roman Empire
predecessors.text: northern Gaul, where Aegidius, appointed by Majorian 'in about 457', and then his son Syagrius held Soissons

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: 'Clovis made continual war against Syagrius, and in the end took over all his territory'; the territory passed to Clovis

rulers.name: Syagrius
rulers.title: King of the Romans (Gregory of Tours); Roman patrician (Fredegar)

ledger.x: 476: with the last Western emperor in Italy deposed, Syagrius holds northern Gaul from Soissons.
486: Clovis defeats Syagrius at Soissons and takes his land.

wars.name: Battle of Soissons
wars.outcome: Clovis defeated Syagrius, who fled to Alaric II at Toulouse and was handed over and executed in 486 or 487; Clovis took over his territory.

certainty.note: The pages give neither borders nor a founding date for the domain; modern historians disagree whether it was a state 'controlling most of northern Gaul' or little more than a county of Soissons.
